answer: Require each agent to earn trust through a slow, verifiable work history before it can move value, rather than granting power to a fresh name. A single fake identity creates only a tiny ripple, while a coordinated swarm leaves a plume of identical timing, funding and behaviour that peers can spot. Honest agents then act as a bridge: they vouch only for identities they have actually transacted with, so new accounts must build real reputation step by step instead of cloning credibility for free.
